mentions.name: Calens
mentions.description: This app adds analytics and better editing to Google Calendar. It provides a GitHub-style heatmap showing 52 weeks of calendar activity, weekly/monthly time breakdowns by calendar or tag, a progress chart of planned vs completed time, and a cleaner in-page event editor. Everything runs on-device in the browser with no servers and no tracking.
mentions.problem: Google Workspace's Time Insights is locked to paid accounts and doesn't work for personal Google Calendar, so users can't answer where their time actually went each week.
mentions.audience: Google Calendar users who log their life in the calendar and want better data on their habits
